notes.text: The linked Yoma passage names Rav Chaviva bar Surmaki, who reports a difficulty. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1172&lang=en) discusses the same report under Yoma 6a and records an Ein Yaakov reading with Rabbi Abba. The Hebrew notice retains its doubled period.
